callScript: "Hi Fitness Empire team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, mobile-first speed, and highlighting your top 4.8-star rating in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?
